column1: # Muscle Bomber / Saturday Night Slam Masters (CPS1.5 `slammast`) ARRANGE LOOPS
#   FM Towns "Muscle Bomber: The Body Explosion" CD-DA, all 29 audio tracks.
#   A `one_shot` row has loop_start/loop_end = 0 and is stored whole, unlooped.
# 44100 Hz stereo frame units, indexing cd_full/trNN.wav as extracted (pregap
# already trimmed).  Playback semantics: play from sample 0, and on reaching
# WHY ALMOST EVERYTHING IS A ONE-SHOT.  Only the nine arena/stage themes loop.
# Every other cue is a one-shot because the ARCADE's own cue is one: held in
# the service-mode sound test, the board's title theme plays ~19 s and then
# falls to silence (RMS 0.5) for the remaining 70 s of a 90 s hold, even
# though the title screen itself lasts 41-68 s.  The same is true of the short
# cues (ranking 5.9 s audible against a 6.5 s track).  So a one-shot does not
# fall short of the board -- it reproduces it.  Storing each track WHOLE also
# means no cue can outrun its audio regardless of context.
# The `arcade_window_s` column is the longest the GAME was measured holding
# that cue, across pure attract, a driven tournament to the ending, and a
# no-input route.  It is documentation, not a build input.
